//: Module-boundary rules for the project graph, in Nx's depConstraints shape: a project tagged sourceTag may depend (a Cargo path dependency of any kind, or an Nx implicitDependency) only on projects carrying one of onlyDependOnTags. Enforced by tools/check-project-boundaries.mjs (workspace:lint). The library contract (allowlister-remote's prompt surface) depends on nothing in this repo but other contracts; apps, the e2e suite and the CI tooling may depend on the contract (the root project, which also owns the root files they read); nothing but the repo-level checks (type:workspace, e.g. the coverage aggregate) may depend on the e2e suite.
